<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="2W9uefzKbYdMU1RImVCk" name="Page-6"> <mxGraphModel dx="2440" dy="881" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam nodesep 55
skinparam ranksep 60
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam roundcorner 4

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
 ArrowColor #1e3a8a
 BorderColor #3b82f6
 HeaderBackgroundColor #f1f5f9
 FontName Arial
 FontSize 11
}

skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #F8FAFC
 BorderColor #CBD5E1
 FontColor #475569
 FontStyle bold
}

' ==========================================
' TIER 1: INSTITUTION & CALENDAR CONFIGURATION
' ==========================================
package \"Tier 1: School & Calendar Configuration\" {
 entity \"schools\" as schools {
 * id : PK
 --
 name : varchar
 code : varchar
 created_at : timestamp
 }

 entity \"grading_scales\" as grading_scales {
 * id : PK
 --
 school_id : FK
 name : varchar
 min_score : decimal
 max_score : decimal
 grade : varchar
 remark : varchar
 }

 entity \"academic_years\" as academic_years {
 * id : PK
 --
 school_id : FK
 name : varchar
 start_date : date
 end_date : date
 created_at : timestamp
 updated_at : timestamp
 }

 entity \"terms\" as terms {
 * id : PK
 --
 academic_year_id : FK
 term_number : int
 start_date : date
 end_date : date
 }
}

' ==========================================
' TIER 2: AUTHENTICATION, ROLES & ACADEMIC HIERARCHY
' ==========================================
package \"Tier 2: Academic Hierarchy & Access Control\" {
 entity \"grades\" as grades {
 * id : PK
 --
 school_id : FK
 name : varchar
 level : int
 }

 entity \"streams\" as streams {
 * id : PK
 --
 grade_id : FK
 name : varchar
 }

 entity \"roles\" as roles {
 * id : PK
 --
 name : varchar
 description : text
 }

 entity \"profiles\" as profiles {
 * id : PK
 --
 full_name : varchar
 phone : varchar
 created_at : timestamp
 }

 entity \"user_roles\" as user_roles {
 * id : PK
 --
 user_id : FK
 role_id : FK
 school_id : FK
 created_at : timestamp
 }
}

' ==========================================
' TIER 3: STUDENTS, ENROLLMENTS & TEACHER WORKLOAD
' ==========================================
package \"Tier 3: Student Enrollments & Staff Workload\" {
 entity \"students\" as students {
 * id : PK
 --
 school_id : FK
 admission_number : varchar
 full_name : varchar
 status : varchar
 created_at : timestamp
 }

 entity \"student_enrollments\" as student_enrollments {
 * id : PK
 --
 student_id : FK
 stream_id : FK
 academic_year_id : FK
 start_date : date
 end_date : date
 created_at : timestamp
 }

 entity \"parent_students\" as parent_students {
 * id : PK
 --
 parent_id : FK
 student_id : FK
 verification_status : varchar
 verified_at : timestamp
 verified_by : FK
 created_at : timestamp
 }

 entity \"class_teacher_assignments\" as class_teacher_assignments {
 * id : PK
 --
 teacher_id : FK
 stream_id : FK
 academic_year_id : FK
 }

 entity \"subject_teacher_assignments\" as subject_teacher_assignments {
 * id : PK
 --
 teacher_id : FK
 stream_id : FK
 learning_area_id : FK
 academic_year_id : FK
 }
}

' ==========================================
' TIER 4: CURRICULUM, ASSESSMENTS & RESULTS ENGINE
' ==========================================
package \"Tier 4: Curriculum, CBC Assessments & Scoring\" {
 entity \"learning_areas\" as learning_areas {
 * id : PK
 --
 school_id : FK
 name : varchar
 code : varchar
 is_active : boolean
 }

 entity \"assessments\" as assessments {
 * id : PK
 --
 school_id : FK
 academic_year_id : FK
 term_id : FK
 learning_area_id : FK
 name : varchar
 assessment_type : varchar
 max_score : decimal
 status : varchar
 created_by : FK
 created_at : timestamp
 }

 entity \"student_results\" as student_results {
 * id : PK
 --
 assessment_id : FK
 student_id : FK
 score : decimal
 grade : varchar
 remark : text
 entered_by : FK
 updated_at : timestamp
 }
}

' ==========================================
' RELATIONSHIPS & CARDINALITIES
' ==========================================

' Tier 1 Links
schools ||--o{ grading_scales
schools ||--o{ academic_years
academic_years ||--o{ terms

' Tier 1 to Tier 2 Links
schools ||--o{ grades
grades ||--o{ streams
schools ||--o{ user_roles
roles ||--o{ user_roles
profiles ||--o{ user_roles

' Tier 2 & Tier 1 to Tier 3 Links
schools ||--o{ students
students ||--o{ student_enrollments
streams ||--o{ student_enrollments
academic_years ||--o{ student_enrollments

students ||--o{ parent_students
profiles ||--o{ parent_students

profiles ||--o{ class_teacher_assignments
streams ||--o{ class_teacher_assignments
academic_years ||--o{ class_teacher_assignments

profiles ||--o{ subject_teacher_assignments
streams ||--o{ subject_teacher_assignments
academic_years ||--o{ subject_teacher_assignments

' Tier 4 Curriculum & Scoring Engine Links
schools ||--o{ learning_areas
learning_areas ||--o{ subject_teacher_assignments

schools ||--o{ assessments
academic_years ||--o{ assessments
terms ||--o{ assessments
learning_areas ||--o{ assessments
profiles ||--o{ assessments

assessments ||--o{ student_results
students ||--o{ student_results
profiles ||--o{ student_results
